{{Quote|It's not so bad&hellip; I ran into tougher customers during the Quesaya Border Conflict.|A former Galactic Republic rocket-jumper|<ref name="TotJC">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]''</ref>}}
The '''Quesaya Border Conflict''' took place in [[4007 BBY]]<ref name="Author's Cut" /> in the vicinity of the [[Quesaya system/Legends|Quesaya system]], situated near the edge of the territory that was well-[[Scout/Legends|explored]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TEA" /> The conflict saw the participation of the Republic's [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit]]. The rocket-jumpers fought bravely during the event,<ref name="Author's Cut" /> which became known as one of the unit's legendary exploits.<ref name="GaW">''[[Galaxy at War]]''</ref> When a [[Unidentified rocket-jumper|former rocket-jumper]] who had fought in the Quesaya Border Conflict became involved in a confrontation<ref name="TotJC" /> [[4000 BBY/Legends|seven years]] later,<ref name="Date">''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'' is set 4,000 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the events of [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], which translates to [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> they noted that they had faced a fiercer adversary during the former conflict.<ref name="TotJC" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Tales_of_the_Jedi_Companion.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The Quesaya Border Conflict was introduced in the ''Tales of the Jedi Companion''.]]
The Quesaya Border Conflict was first mentioned in the [[1996]] [[roleplaying game]] sourcebook ''[[Tales of the Jedi Companion]]'', written by [[George R. Strayton]] and published by [[West End Games]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TotJC" />

The conflict was originally meant to be mentioned in the [[2012]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]]; however, the section that would have mentioned the event was cut before the book's release. The information regarding the Quesaya Border Conflict was later released in [[2014]] as part of [[Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut|''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut]], a series of articles published on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars Blog|Blog]] by Fry and<ref name="Author's Cut" /> [[Del Rey]] editor<ref name="Celestials">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-guide-to-warfare-authors-cut-the-celestials|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare'' Author's Cut &mdash; The Celestials|int=Star Wars: The Essential Guide to Warfare Author's Cut}}</ref> [[Erich Schoeneweiss]] containing various cut content from the book.<ref name="Author's Cut" />
